title: BO Team Exploits Log4Shell in VMware vCenter, Compromises Russian Firm's Code-Signing Server
content_md: An investigation into suspicious activity within a Russian software developer's network has uncovered a months-long compromise of its development infrastructure and a software code-signing server. The activity, documented by Kaspersky's ICS CERT team after it was contacted by the affected developer in June 2025, has been attributed to a threat actor named BO Team (aka Black Owl, Hoody Hyena,

CVE-2021-44228.evidence: Kaspersky ICS CERT attributes the compromise to BO Team, who exploited Log4Shell in VMware vCenter to reach the code-signing server; the actor maintained access for months before discovery.
